items.name: Ella
items.tagline: Mist-Veiled Peaks, Ravana Legends & Highland Tea Estates
items.summary: Perched on the southern rim of the Central Massif, Ella captivates with dramatic mountain vistas, historic stone viaducts, and crisp mountain air perfumed with freshly withered tea leaf notes.
curations: Dawn trek to Little Adam’s Peak before mist lifts
Nine Arches Viaduct blue train private viewing pass
Single-estate artisanal tea tasting with master planter

cover.alt: Aerial dawn panorama of the Ella Gap with ridges dropping to the southern plains

items.name: Sigiriya & Dambulla
items.summary: Ascend King Kashyapa’s monolith citadel and explore five sacred cliffside chambers filled with 150+ gilded Buddha statues.
curations: Dawn VIP gate ascent prior to general opening
Private royal water garden champagne picnic
Dambulla cave fresco analysis with heritage lecturer

cover.alt: Sigiriya Lion Rock above misty jungle canopy at dawn

items.name: Galle Fort
items.summary: Living UNESCO fortress where colonial Dutch architecture merges with bespoke gemstone ateliers, private villas, and bastion sunset vistas.
curations: Flag Rock Bastion sunset walk with local historian
Exclusive Ceylon sapphire atelier private viewing
Private architectural tour of hidden Dutch courtyards

cover.alt: Galle Fort ramparts and lighthouse above cobalt surf at sunset

items.name: Yala & Bundala
items.tagline: Untamed Scrublands, Leopard Dens & Lagoon Aviaries
items.summary: Home to the highest leopard density on earth, wild Asian elephant herds, and Bundala’s UNESCO biosphere where thousands of migratory flamingos gather.
curations: Dedicated modified custom 4x4 with senior wildlife tracker
Quiet remote Block 5 and Lunugamvehera elephant corridor access
Bundala salt pan migratory bird expedition with telephoto optics

cover.alt: Leopard resting on a granite outcrop in Yala at golden hour

items.name: Kandy & Knuckles
items.tagline: The Sacred Tooth Temple & UNESCO Cloud Forest
items.summary: Sri Lanka’s last royal kingdom steeped in ritual drum ceremonies, surrounded by the rugged Knuckles range where endemic orchids bloom.
curations: Private VIP inner-chamber morning puja at Temple of the Tooth
Knuckles mountain cloud-forest trek with botanist
Royal Peradeniya Botanical Walk exploring historic spice trees

cover.alt: Temple of the Tooth beside Kandy Lake with misty hills behind

items.name: Mirissa & Weligama
items.tagline: Azure Bays, Blue Whale Marine Highway & Coconut Cliffs
items.summary: Sun-drenched coastal retreat renowned for deep-sea blue whale passages, tranquil surf breaks, and secluded private beachfront estates.
curations: Private catamaran charter with marine conservationist
Sunset stilt fishermen portrait session at Ahangama
Koggala Lake cinnamon plantation private launch cruise

cover.alt: Palm headland above a turquoise bay at Weligama and Mirissa

items.name: Nuwara Eliya
items.tagline: Little England, Alpine Turf & High-Grown Ceylon Pekoe
items.summary: The highest highland settlement in Ceylon, celebrated for temperate alpine gardens, fireside dining, and world-renowned orthodox high-grown tea factories.
curations: 19th-century Hill Club private silver tea service
Single-estate Pedro Tea Factory private drying-room tour
Hakgala sub-tropical cliff gardens curated morning stroll

cover.alt: Red-brick colonial estate and rose gardens in Nuwara Eliya

items.name: Trincomalee & Pasikudah
items.tagline: Deep Natural Harbor, Koneswaram Cliff & Coral Reefs
items.summary: Unspoiled east coastline blessed with crystal-still shallow bays, vibrant coral life at Pigeon Island, and thousands of years of Tamil naval history.
curations: Swami Rock temple cliff sunset with Hindu devotional chants
Pigeon Island private boat snorkeling with reef sharks
Secluded Marble Beach picnic with fresh seafood grill

cover.alt: Koneswaram temple on a cliff above the sapphire sea at Trincomalee

items.name: Anuradhapura & Polonnaruwa
items.tagline: Ancient Capitals, the Sacred Bodhi & Gal Vihara Masterpieces
items.summary: Two UNESCO royal capitals spanning fifteen centuries — towering stupas, the world’s oldest documented tree and serene granite Buddhas, explored by bicycle at an unhurried pace.
curations: Vintage-bicycle ride through Polonnaruwa’s royal precinct
Gal Vihara at first light with a heritage lecturer
Evening pirith chanting at the Sri Maha Bodhi

cover.alt: Stone Buddha statues and ruins of Polonnaruwa in golden afternoon light

items.name: Udawalawe
items.tagline: Asia’s Most Reliable Wild Elephant Encounters
items.summary: Open savannah around a great reservoir where herds of wild Asian elephants graze in plain view — and where orphaned calves are rehabilitated for release back into the wild.
curations: Dawn jeep safari among grazing elephant herds
Feeding-time visit to the Elephant Transit Home
Junior naturalist kits for young explorers

cover.alt: Tusker walking through golden grass in Udawalawe National Park

items.name: Colombo
items.tagline: Colonial Cinnamon Mansions, Geoffrey Bawa Architecture & Coastal Sunsets
items.summary: Sri Lanka’s lively maritime capital, where Dutch-era warehouses, cinnamon-garden mansions and Geoffrey Bawa’s tropical modernism meet street-food theatre on the Galle Face promenade.
curations: Private viewing of Geoffrey Bawa’s Number 11 townhouse
Pettah market walk with a spice merchant
Kottu theatre and sunset kites on Galle Face Green

cover.alt: Oceanfront gala dinner with white linen tables at a Colombo heritage hotel

items.name: Bentota
items.tagline: Lunuganga Gardens, River Safaris & Ayurvedic Retreats
items.summary: A palm-fringed river-mouth resort on the west coast, home to Geoffrey Bawa’s Lunuganga estate, gentle estuary waters for boating and some of the island’s most respected Ayurveda retreats.
curations: Contemplative walk through Bawa’s Lunuganga gardens
Bentota river and mangrove boat safari
Kosgoda sea turtle conservation visit
